title: Hardship Share of the Reconnection Payment for Electric Service Agreements Supported by Energy Assistance Agencies
content:
**Clause 1 — Share.** The basis of the reconnection payment for a disconnected Electric Service Agreement is multiplied by a hardship share of 0.6 when the agreement received two or more payments from an energy assistance agency in the 12 calendar months before the payment, 0.8 when it received exactly one such payment, and 1 when it received none.

**Clause 2 — Point of action.** The hardship share multiplies the basis, taken never below zero, before that amount is rounded to the cent; the share is not rounded on its own.

**Clause 3 — Payments counted.** The payments counted are those posted to the agreement through the energy assistance agency channel. Every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date.

| Energy assistance agency payments in the 12 calendar months before the payment | Hardship share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.6 |
| exactly 1 | 0.8 |
| none | 1 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** One agency payment dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the payment and another dated exactly 12 whole calendar months before it: only the first counts, so the share is 0.8. Both dated within the 12 months: the share is 0.6.

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A basis of 455.00 USD with exactly one agency payment in the period is multiplied by 0.8, giving 364.00 USD; with two or more it is multiplied by 0.6, giving 273.00 USD; with none it stays 455.00 USD.
